result.detail: The formal proof required by interface spec section 7 is not delivered here. A follow-up task, or this seat on rework, should add exactly one formal_spec (apb_regs.sby) that reads apb_regs.v with read -formal. The properties should be written independently of the RTL decode, as the microarchitecture asks, and should cover every register being written and read back. The failure-path testbench apb_regs_tb_fail.v is also outstanding. Both files carry `timescale 1ns / 1ps, so Verilator does not raise TIMESCALEMOD when they are compiled together. Expected values in the testbench come from its own tb_mapped and tb_merge functions, not from the RTL.
